headword: クラシック{音楽|おんがく}

definitions.explanation: Western art music in the tradition of composers such as Bach, Mozart, and Beethoven, as well as the broader genre encompassing orchestral, chamber, and operatic works.

examples.japanese: クラシック{音楽|おんがく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧クラシック{音楽|おんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a classical music concert on the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧クラシック{音楽|おんがく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛好者|あいこうしゃ}→愛好者：29205_aikousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{各地|かくち}→各地：00155_kakuchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{市民|しみん}→市民：01426_shimin⟧⟦オーケストラ→オーケストラ：04466_ookesutora⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}する→存在する：17185_sonzaisuru⟧。
examples.english: In Japan there are many classical music enthusiasts, and community orchestras exist throughout the country.

notes:
Often shortened to simply ⟦クラシック→クラシック：03838_kurashikku⟧ in casual speech. Japan has a thriving classical music culture, with many professional orchestras and a tradition of music education ({音楽教室|おんがくきょうしつ}) that begins in childhood.
